label: Late original-phase steps (t>=5) and <DEL> in sequences starting with l
explanation: Fires only in the original phase and at the <DEL> step, never during copy, and almost only when the first original token is l (first_tok=l is 23x lift and holds 87% of activation mass; x is a weak second at 6%). It is silent at t<=2, rare at t=3-4, and peaks around t=5-7 (orig_idx 5-8), mostly near the end of the input (to_go 0-2). The strongest activations are in sequences like l v a t ..., l n a v e ..., l a v a ..., where a appears among the first three tokens, and on inputs such as w, c, v, j or 2. Even so, a in early positions explains only about 17% of the mass, so it raises magnitude but does not decide whether the feature fires. Within l-initial sequences firing is sparse and depends on content: precision is only about 0.35, and many late steps of l-sequences stay silent. Missed activations (18% of mass) are weak firings in sequences starting with x, v, i or 3.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=l (+8.05), orig0=x (+4.11), orig0=3 (+3.00), prev_tok=2 (+2.69), orig0=v (+2.51), orig1=v (+2.50). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-8.83), phase=2 (-8.21), t=3 (-4.26), orig2=h (-3.09).
